turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Pray, proceed, Your Majesty. I am all attention, and my mind is prepared to grasp the intricacies of your case.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand that this matter is of the utmost gravity, and that the consequences of failure would be...catastrophic.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: And I must say, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the gravity of the matter. May I ask if there is any particular reason why you have chosen to seek the assistance of Mr. Holmes, and not, perhaps, the authorities?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I perceive that you are attempting to convey a sense of urgency, but so far, Your Majesty, you have merely stated the gravity of the situation without providing any specifics. Pray, tell me, what is the nature of this catastrophic consequence that hangs in the balance?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I implore you, gentlemen, to believe me when I say that this matter is of the utmost delicacy. The eyes of Europe are upon me, and the slightest misstep would have far-reaching consequences for my kingdom and for the balance of power in Europe.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I am somewhat perplexed by the mention of the balance of power in Europe. Can you provide some clarity on how this matter relates to your kingdom and the potential consequences?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I dare not reveal the details just yet, gentlemen, but I assure you that my kingdom's very existence hangs in the balance. The consequences of failure would be...irreparable.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist on a more precise explanation, Your Majesty. The weight of your words suggests a tangled web of intrigue, and I am not one to be swayed by vague threats or royal prerogatives.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that your words have piqued my interest, and I am eager to hear more about the matter that has brought you to our doorstep.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that the burden of secrecy weighs heavily upon me, and I fear that I may be putting too great a trust in your discretion.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Come now, Your Majesty, I am not one to be swayed by royal entreaties. You must trust me with more substantial information if you expect me to assist you in this matter.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the gravity of your situation, and I find myself wondering what kind of circumstances could possibly threaten your kingdom's very existence.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand that my position is one of the utmost delicacy, and I fear that even to speak of this matter further may be to invite catastrophe.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that your concern for discretion is quite understandable, but I am still puzzled by the nature of this matter. Might I ask if there is something specific that has led you to believe that your situation is so precarious?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I warn you, Your Majesty, that your hesitation is beginning to cloud the issue. Pray, let us proceed with all due haste, and we shall see if we can uncover the root of your distress.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I dare not breathe a word, gentlemen, of the particulars that have led me to seek your assistance. The very thought of it is enough to make my blood run cold.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must confess, Your Majesty, that your evasiveness is beginning to pique my curiosity, and I find myself wondering if there is something that you are not telling us.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I implore you, gentlemen, to believe me when I say that my silence is not born of obstinacy, but of a genuine and abiding fear for the safety of those I hold dear.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I perceive that you are struggling to maintain a delicate balance between candour and prudence. I must insist that you reveal to me the substance of your concern, no matter how distasteful or compromising it may seem.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand the gravity of the situation, and to trust me when I say that the revelation of my true identity would be the very last thing I wish to happen.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
